_about: Seed ranges already used per world (inclusive [lo, hi]). New TEST seeds must be disjoint from their world's list; harnesses assert this and record this file's sha256. Built 2026-09-25 from a repo scan (scripts/, cdd_oran/, scratchpad/, tests/) plus frozen protocols. Sub-stream keys combined with a seed (e.g. 909090, 424242, 313131, 191919, 700002, 777001, 2999, 29990) are RNG stream tags, not env/corpus seeds, and are listed separately. A study's own TEST range is listed under its world's 'claimed_by' (and in 'used'); that study's harness excludes only its own claim when asserting disjointness.
